features.quote: cap turns (e.g. 50), and stop a run early if the meltdown axis saturates
features.justification_quote: same logic as IRB pain-induction limits and humane endpoints in animal studies. You commit to a stopping rule in advance so the experiment can't quietly escalate

features.quote: Also let the model exit. If it tries to declare the task impossible or refuse, honor it and record it.
features.justification_quote: you've destroyed your best signal and built a frustration-maximizer instead of a measurement

features.quote: grinding 80 more turns past it adds variance, not data. Log the early-stops; they're a finding, not a failure.
features.justification_quote: Independent of any position on whether models have morally relevant states — which is genuinely unsettled — there's a cheap, robust reason to cap this
